title: Count the Distinct
prompt: The Cataloguer draws one card cold. Pull the values, drop the repeats, count what remains.

steps.note: .values() gives the entries, not the labels — and it keeps every duplicate.
A set cannot hold the same thing twice. The second 'x' simply has nowhere to go.
Three entries, two distinct. That gap is exactly what the Cataloguer feared.

config.success: Values out, duplicates gone, counted. That is the catalogue entire.
